d: We Put the World on Vacation

Travel + Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide.

Discover a career fuelled by possibility at Travel & Leisure Co. If you are a professional and safety-focused driver with a commitment to exceptional service, join our team as a Corporate Driver and become an important part of supporting our business operations across the UAE.
Provide safe, reliable, and professional transportation for executives, employees, guests, and VIPs.
Ensure all journeys are conducted in accordance with local traffic laws and company safety standards.
Maintain assigned vehicles in a clean, presentable, and roadworthy condition at all times.
Conduct daily vehicle inspections and promptly report any maintenance or repair requirements.
Coordinate transport schedules and ensure punctual pick-up and drop-off arrangements.
Assist with airport transfers, business meetings, site visits, and corporate events as required.
Support the delivery and collection of company documents, packages, and materials when needed.
Plan efficient travel routes to minimise delays and optimise travel time.
Keep accurate records of mileage, fuel consumption, servicing, and vehicle logs.
Maintain confidentiality regarding company information, executive travel, and business activities.
Assist with administrative or operational support tasks when transportation duties permit.
Demonstrate a professional and courteous approach when interacting with all stakeholders.
Build your career with a value-driven organisation that promotes continual growth and development for its people. Some of our many benefits on offer include:
Discounted hotel stays across Accor properties and partner destinations.
r: Previous experience as a Corporate Driver, Executive Driver, Chauffeur, or in a similar professional driving position.
A valid UAE driving licence with a clean driving record.
Strong knowledge of UAE roads, routes, and traffic regulations.
Excellent time management and organisational skills.
A customer-service-oriented attitude with a high level of discretion and confidentiality.
Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.
Basic vehicle maintenance knowledge and awareness.
Arabic and English language skills are advantageous.
Flexibility to work varying schedules, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and public holidays when required.
A proactive, dependable, and safety-focused approach to work.

As a Corporate Driver, you will play a key role in ensuring our leaders, employees, and guests experience safe, efficient, and professional transportation services while representing the values and standards of Travel & Leisure Co at all times.

Hospitality is at the heart of all we do at Travel + Leisure Co. Here, you’ll find an inclusive environment where we deliver excellence and take time to have fun, celebrate together, and support one another. We're always looking ahead to what’s next and how we can strengthen our business, its neighboring communities, and the customer experience. Join our global team and build a career where memories start with you.
